string.name: gboard_patches_error_header_summary

string.name: gboard_patches_error_row_summary
string.translation: The host app stayed alive. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_fatal_fallback_summary
string.translation: This screen hit an internal error and was safely disabled. Gboard stays alive. Reopen settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_search_no_results_summary
string.translation: Try a shorter or different keyword.

string.name: gboard_patches_restart_failed
string.translation: Gboard could not be restarted. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_package_warning_message
string.translation: The current Gboard package is %1$s. GinType supports only the official package com.google.android.inputmethod.latin and dev.srwi.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin. Mixing Gboard builds from multiple sources may cause instability.

string.translation: Unable to open Developer options for %1$s.

string.translation: Unable to open the Speech Recognition & Synthesis Google Play page.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_live_transcribe_open_failed
string.translation: Unable to open Live Transcribe or its Google Play page.

string.name: gboard_patches_flag_patch_error_summary
string.translation: The patch setting screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_summary
string.translation: Expanded suggestion bar with multi-row words and swipe navigation

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_topbar_scale_summary
string.translation: Adjust the height and text size of the suggestion bar

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_invert_swipe_summary
string.translation: Reverse vertical swipe direction when picking suggestions from the upper or lower row

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_swipe_sensitivity_summary
string.translation: Higher values require shorter horizontal swipes to switch words

string.name: gboard_patches_thicc_top_bar_multi_word_select_summary
string.translation: Double-tap and drag left or right on the suggestion bar to select multiple words

item.translation: Restart Gboard (%1$d change waiting to apply)
Restart Gboard (%1$d changes waiting to apply)

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_summary
string.translation: Swipe words with two fingers at once, while single-finger glide typing stays normal

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_enabled_summary
string.translation: Use both thumbs to swipe parts of a word together. Single-finger swiping still works as usual.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_auto_space_summary
string.translation: Automatically insert spaces between two-finger words

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_space_placement_summary
string.translation: Choose whether spaces are added before the next word or after each word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_auto_space_delay_summary
string.translation: How long to wait after lifting your fingers before finalizing the word and adding a space

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_combine_enabled_summary
string.translation: Combine quick single-finger swipes into one word instead of starting a new word each time

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_combine_delay_summary
string.translation: How long to wait for the next swipe before treating it as a new word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_tap_to_multiglide_enabled_title
string.translation: Continue tapped letters with a swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_tap_to_multiglide_enabled_summary
string.translation: If you tap a few letters and then swipe with two fingers, combine them into one word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_tap_to_multiglide_delay_summary
string.translation: How long recent letter taps count toward a two-finger swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_smart_tap_swipe_split_enabled_summary
string.translation: Insert a space instead of combining when a 1–3 letter tap prefix and the following swipe make more sense as separate words

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_spacebar_timer_indicator_summary
string.translation: Display a visual bar on the spacebar while waiting to finish the word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_word_ready_vibration_title
string.translation: Vibrate when ready for new word

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_word_ready_vibration_summary
string.translation: Give a subtle vibration when the word timer expires and a new word can begin

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_backspace_mode_summary
string.translation: What Backspace does right after a two-finger swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_backspace_mode_last_input
string.translation: Undo last swipe or tap before word is finished

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_summary
string.translation: Fine-tune swipe accuracy vs. common-word preference

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_header_summary
string.translation: Adjust how strictly the decoder follows your exact finger path versus favoring common words. Default values work best for most people.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_beam_width_summary
string.translation: How many word candidates the decoder tracks per letter. Higher values can improve accuracy for long words, but use slightly more battery.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_freq_weight_floor_summary
string.translation: Prevent common words from overriding rare words you swiped accurately. Higher = easier to type uncommon words.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_geo_exponent_summary
string.translation: How closely your swipe must match the exact letters. Higher = follow your path strictly; lower = allow messier swipes.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_beam_freq_weight_summary
string.translation: How strongly everyday words are preferred while matching your swipe. 0 = match finger path only.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_error_summary
string.translation: The MultiGlide settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_diagnostics_summary
string.translation: Record and export logs for troubleshooting

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_trace_logging_summary
string.translation: Record touch paths, timings, and decoder candidates to local trace logs for troubleshooting.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_trace_export_summary
string.translation: Choose how many minutes back to export recorded trace events as JSONL.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_trace_export_error
string.translation: Enter a duration between 1 and 1440 minutes.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_trace_export_empty
string.translation: No trace log entries found in the selected time window.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_trace_clear_summary
string.translation: Delete locally stored MultiGlide trace log files.

string.name: gboard_patches_multiglide_trace_clear_confirm_message
string.translation: Delete all recorded MultiGlide trace log files?

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_reset_summary
string.translation: Restore all decoder parameters to their default values

string.name: gboard_patches_kinetica_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: Search depth, rare word boost, path strictness, and common word preference will be restored to defaults.

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_summary
string.translation: Rainbow swipe trail, glitter particles, and tap or release explosions

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_enabled_summary
string.translation: Master switch for all visual show effects on the keyboard

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_rainbow_trail_summary
string.translation: Replace the default swipe trail and MultiGlide chord accent with an animated color trail for single-finger and MultiGlide gestures

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_trail_glow_summary
string.translation: Add a luminous outer aura and bright core highlight to the swipe trail

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_glitter_summary
string.translation: Emit shimmering glitter particles behind your fingers while swiping

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_tap_explosion_summary
string.translation: Burst particles at your fingertip whenever you tap a key

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_release_explosion_summary
string.translation: Trigger a celebratory burst when lifting a finger at the end of a swipe

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_shockwave_ring_summary
string.translation: Add an expanding luminous ring to tap and swipe-release explosions

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_key_highlight_summary
string.translation: Illuminates touched and swiped-over keys with a glowing highlight that fades out smoothly

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_key_highlight_style_summary
string.translation: Visual style used to highlight touched keys

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_key_highlight_duration_summary
string.translation: How long touched keys stay illuminated before fading out

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_keyboard_warp_summary
string.translation: Flex and depress touched and neighboring keys like an elastic trampoline with spring rebound

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_warp_strength_summary
string.translation: How deeply keys depress, tilt, and pull toward your finger

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_warp_radius_summary
string.translation: How far the trampoline wave spreads across surrounding keys

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_wind_summary
string.translation: Flowing ambient air ribbons that loosely follow your swipe trajectory in a wide corridor

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_wind_intensity_summary
string.translation: How many wind gusts appear and how vivid they look while swiping

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_wind_spread_summary
string.translation: How wide around your swipe path the ambient wind ribbons flow

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_palette_summary
string.translation: Color theme used for trails, glitter, and explosions

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_explosion_style_summary
string.translation: Visual particle shape for tap and swipe-release bursts

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_glitter_style_summary
string.translation: Particle shape emitted along your swipe path

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_trail_width_summary
string.translation: Thickness of the swipe ribbon at your fingertip

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_trail_fade_summary
string.translation: How long swipe trails linger before fading away

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_rainbow_speed_summary
string.translation: How rapidly rainbow and palette colors shift along the trail

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_particle_count_summary
string.translation: Number of particles spawned per tap or swipe-release explosion

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_glitter_density_summary
string.translation: How densely glitter particles spawn while swiping

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_particle_size_summary
string.translation: Scale of sparks, stars, confetti, and shockwave rings

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_particle_lifetime_summary
string.translation: How long explosion and glitter particles stay visible

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_particle_speed_summary
string.translation: Initial burst velocity of explosion and glitter particles

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_reset_summary
string.translation: Restore all Typing Effects toggles, styles, and sliders to default values

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: All Typing Effects settings will be restored to their default values.

string.name: gboard_patches_typing_effects_error_summary
string.translation: The Typing Effects settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_summary
string.translation: Customize or add characters, symbols, emojis, and text snippets to long-press popups

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_enabled_summary
string.translation: Add or edit symbols when long-pressing keys on the keyboard

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_lock_keys_summary
string.translation: Hide the edit icon and disable hold-to-edit on the keyboard to prevent accidental changes

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_empty_summary
string.translation: Long-press any key and release on the edit icon to add a symbol, or hold on an existing popup symbol for 2 seconds to edit it.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_entry_modified_summary
string.translation: Modified default symbol (original: %1$s) • Tap to edit or reset

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_entry_added_summary
string.translation: Added custom symbol • Tap to edit or delete

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_dialog_add_subtitle
string.translation: Enter a character, symbol, emoji, or text snippet to add to the long-press popup of key "%1$s".

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_dialog_edit_added_subtitle
string.translation: Update or delete this custom symbol on key "%1$s".

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_dialog_edit_default_subtitle
string.translation: Replace this default symbol (original: "%2$s") on key "%1$s", or reset it to the original symbol.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_dialog_error_empty
string.translation: Please enter at least one character.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_dialog_error_reserved_pencil
string.translation: The edit icon (✎) is reserved and cannot be used as a hold symbol.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_dialog_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: Reset this hold slot on key "%2$s" back to "%1$s"?

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_add_binding_summary
string.translation: Choose a key and add a custom hold symbol (works even when keys are locked)

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_reset_summary
string.translation: Remove all added symbols and restore all modified default hold popup symbols

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: All custom added symbols will be deleted and all modified default symbols will be restored to their original values.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_reset_done
string.translation: All custom hold bindings have been reset.

string.name: gboard_patches_custom_hold_popups_error_summary
string.translation: The Custom Hold Popups settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
